standard.rule_description: The sets of performance curves specified in Table J-2 should be used to represent part-load performance of chillers in the baseline building design.

rule-22-42-a.test_description: The project has one building segment with two zones served by a water cooled baseline system type 7 with a chilled water system. The chilled water system consists of a  100-ton, 0.61 kW/ton water cooled centrifugal chiller, with performance curves that agree with Table J-2, curve set Z.

standard.rule_description: The sets of performance curves specified in Table J-2 should be used to represent part-load performance of chillers in the baseline building design.

rule-22-42-b.test_description: The project has one building segment with two zones served by a water cooled baseline system type 7 with a chilled water system. The chilled water system consists of a  100-ton, 0.61 kW/ton water cooled centrifugal chiller, however it is missing the capacity and power operating validation points required as by Table J-2 for curve set Z.

standard.rule_description: The sets of performance curves specified in Table J-2 should be used to represent part-load performance of chillers in the baseline building design.

rule-22-42-c.test_description: The project has one building segment with two zones served by a water cooled baseline system type 7 with a chilled water system. The chilled water system consists of a  150-ton, 5.5 COP water cooled centrifugal chiller, with performance curves that do not agree with Table J-2, curves set AA.
